title: Ulangazelelo kwiGumbi eliNgcwele
intro: Ungena kwindawo engcwele ezolileyo uze ubone umkhonzi ka-Allah ozinikeleyo emi ethandaza. Izandla zabo ziphakanyisiwe, amehlo abo aphakanyisiwe, kwaye iintliziyo zabo zithwele umnqweno oye waqhubeka ubomi babo bonke. Ngubani lo mphefumlo onomonde okholose ku-Allah olungazange lugungqiswe?
clues: Ndichithe iminyaka emininzi ndinqula kwaye ndithandaza, ndibona imimangaliso eyaqinisa ukholo lwam.
Ndanikwa uxanduva lokunyamekela umphefumlo oselula osikelelekileyo kwindawo engcwele.
Njengoko ndandikhula, eyona ntlungu yam yayikukuba ndandingenamntwana, kuba umfazi wam wayeyinyumba kwaye sobabini sasisele sikhulile.
Ndathandaza eNkosini yam ukuba ndifumane umlandeli ovela kusapho lwam, umntu owayeza kuqhubeka nelifa lobuprofeti.
Ndithe ndimi kwindawo yokuthandaza, iingelosi zandibiza, zisithi, ‘UAllah ukunike iindaba ezimnandi’, ndaza ndoyika kakhulu.
Ndaxelelwa ukuba ndiza kuba nonyana ogama linguYahya, igama elingazange linikwe mntu ngaphambili, kwaye njengomqondiso wokuba andizukuthetha nabantu kangangeentsuku ezintathu.

arabic: وَإِنِّى خِفْتُ ٱلْمَوَٰلِىَ مِن وَرَآءِى وَكَانَتِ ٱمْرَأَتِى عَاقِرًۭا فَهَبْ لِى مِن لَّدُنكَ وَلِيًّۭا
verse: And indeed, I fear the successors after me, and my wife has been barren, so give me from Yourself an heir (19:5)
